method: breaths by loudness (under -16 dB for 0.3 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 7 of 11 breaks heard

lines.latin: Invioláta, íntegra, et casta es María:
lines.english: Inviolate, spotless and chaste art thou, O Mary,

lines.latin: Quæ es effécta fúlgida cæli porta.
lines.english: who art made the shining gate of heaven.
O loving Mother of Christ, most dear,
receive our loving songs of praise.

lines.latin: Te nunc flágitant devóta corda et ora:
lines.english: Devout hearts and lips now beseech thee

lines.latin: Nostra ut pura péctora sint et córpora.
lines.english: that our hearts and bodies may be pure.
